function.arguments: {"observation": "The channel (`email` vs `paid_search`) is not randomly assigned. The email campaign was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers (e.g., loyal and returning), who have higher conversion rates regardless of the campaign. The cross-tabulation shows a clear imbalance: email has 131 loyal, 131 returning, 64 new; paid_search has 26 loyal, 153 returning, 304 new. This imbalance means that a raw difference in conversion rates between channels confounds the effect of the campaign with the effect of customer segment.", "implication": "A raw comparison of conversion rates between `email` and `paid_search` does not estimate the causal effect of the campaign. It instead estimates the difference between two different customer populations. To properly assess the campaign effect, we must adjust for `customer_segment` — either by stratifying, standardising, or modelling the relationship. The raw difference is not a valid estimate of the treatment effect."}
function.name: note_finding
